newsitem.title: USA: Amtech wins $38.6 million Florida toll contract.
newsitem.headline: Amtech wins $38.6 million Florida toll contract.

text.p: Amtech Corp. said Tuesday it received a $38.6 million contract from the Florida Department of Transportation for a state-wide, non-stop electronic toll collection system.
The company said the contract, which was awarded to its Transportation Systems Group unit, was expected to be funded by the Florida Department of Transportation.
It said that the state had already approved the initial funding of $10.4 million, with the balance expected in future ananual instalments.
Implementation of Florida's new SunPass system will begin in late 1997 and is scheduled to be completed in the year 2000, it said.

Amtech will install, integrate, and maintain an advanced version of its Intellitag product line at all Florida Department of Transportation toll locations throughout Florida. Amtech will supply the state Department of Transportation with 327,000 SunPass vehicle tags.

The contract calls for 92 lanes to be dedicated exclusively to electronic toll collection and 16 of the lanes to be designated as express lanes. The new system will also be integrated with existing coin and manual equipment on the remaining 347 lanes, the company said.
